svg.title: Build pipeline of wROdfreq
svg.desc: Six open corpora are counted separately into source_counts and sources. compute_zipf.py writes source_zipf, still per source. merge.py derives the merged table without overwriting the source tables. An optional side branch, build_lemma_layer.py, uses the DEX map to write the separate lemma_zipf table. build_package.py writes three data files for the pip package wrodfreq. validate.py runs last, reads the tables and two reference inputs, and fails the build when a check fails. The raw SQLite database is a second output.
svg.text: Six open corpora, counted separately: 28.75B tokens in total

g.text: build/ingest_<source>.py: one script per source, checkpointed, resumable
All six use one shared tokenizer, wrodfreq/tokenizer.py.
It counts every token, with no dictionary filter.
source_zipf: Zipf and reliable flag, per source
Below 5 occurrences a source abstains; it never reports zero.
It stores each source's floor in sources.
build/merge.py: derives merged from the source tables, never overwrites them
5–6 reliable sources: trimmed mean. 1–4: plain mean.
Sources are never weighted by size.
Ambiguous forms are split, not duplicated.
Optional: the package works without it.
Rows with 3+ hyphens stay out: 6,041,542 words shipped
It fails the build when a check fails.
It reads the tables and recomputes the payloads.
Output: raw SQLite database, for researchers
